steps.title: Analyze Crash on Startup
steps.description: Inspect crash reports and code to identify potential crash vectors, including XML compilation issues and forbidden third-party dependency loading.

steps.title: Remove Forbidden External Dependencies
steps.description: Strip the non-compliant NanoHTTPD implementation from the build.gradle configuration to ensure clean, fully offline native compilation.

steps.title: Correct XML Decimal Values
steps.description: Convert fractional stroke widths in XML drawable resources to robust integer values to prevent rendering parser crashes.

steps.title: Ensure Safe Canvas Clipping Overloads
steps.description: Refactor custom view rendering logic in ImageSandboxView to use standard float overloads for all canvas.clipRect and paint calls, ensuring seamless compatibility across different Android OS levels.

steps.title: Verify Null Safety on Startup
steps.description: Verify all UI controls, textures, and assets are checked for null safety upon initialization before updateMetadata gets called.

steps.title: Building PicBlend Compare
steps.description: Assemble the refined resources and native codebases using Java 17 and AGP 8.3.2.
